prompt.text:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: seamless diffuse/albedo texture for real river-stone meshes in a Japanese anime slice-of-life game.
Input image 1: edit target, the current creek-stone material. Change only this material painting; retain a full-frame square, edge-to-edge stone surface with no separate objects or background.
Primary request: refine it into a clean hand-painted Japanese TV anime stone surface. Use restrained warm pale gray and cool lavender-gray mineral areas with clearer two-to-three-tone painted transitions, a few delicate stone grain marks and small soft mineral flecks. Broader quiet areas should remain, so real small river stones read clearly at gameplay scale. A little subtle beige-gray variation, no green moss layer.
Composition: flat orthographic material swatch, seamless tile in both axes, consistent detail scale across all four edges. It is one continuous stone surface, NOT a field of many separate pebbles, not cobblestones, not a stone wall, no stones outlined as separate islands.
Style: anime background material, crisp restrained painted shapes and soft fine stone character, clean maintained summer community, not photorealistic, not a painting with thick brush strokes, not a 3D render. Keep the surface matte and color-led.
Constraints: diffuse color only under completely neutral uniform illumination. Do NOT paint wet patches, waterlines, moisture gradients, shadows, directional light, highlights, specular reflections, rim light, ambient occlusion, depth or a vignette: the game shaders supply those. No borders, no labels, no text, no watermark, no transparency. Full opaque square texture, ideally 1024x1024.

observed: Clean hand-painted cool gray/lavender and pale warm-gray mineral areas, clearer restrained tonal layers.
Continuous stone material swatch, no separate objects, text, border, or watermark.
No painted waterline, moss band, directional shadow or wet specular highlight; wetting remains shader-controlled.
manual_review.limitation: Texture appearance confirmed in generated original; final stone scale, tiling and underwater visibility still require Root native screenshots.

image_validation.note: Measurements are read-only; no resizing, recoloring, alpha removal or pixel editing was performed.
